scripts.server: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --port 5002 --reload
scripts.infra:init: cd backend && uv run python -m scripts.init_infra
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check app scripts tests
scripts.test:unit: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/unit --cov
scripts.test:integration: mkdir -p reports && cd integration && bru run --env ${BRUNO_ENV:-dev} --sandbox=developer --reporter-junit ../reports/integration-junit.xml --reporter-html ../reports/integration.html
